2019 PORSCHE 911 GT2 RS

WEISSACH PACKAGE, FRONT AXLE LIFT, RYFT EXHAUST SYSTEM, FULL PPF, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The 2019 911 GT2 RS was the most extreme road-going 911 Porsche had ever built at the time. Developed by Porsche's GT division, the GT2 RS combines massive turbocharged power with race-derived aerodynamics and chassis tuning to create a car that feels closer to a street-legal race machine than a traditional sports car. Power comes from a 3.8-liter twin-turbocharged flat-six, producing 700 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque. Paired exclusively with a 7-speed PDK dual-clutch transmission, the GT2 RS sends all of its power to the rear wheels, launching from 0-60 mph in just 2.7 seconds and reaching a top speed of around 211 mph. The acceleration is violent, with massive turbo torque arriving instantly and continuing relentlessly through the rev range. Unlike naturally aspirated GT3 models that reward high revs, the GT2 RS overwhelms with sheer force––making it one of the fastest accelerating rear-wheel-drive cars ever produced. The chassis is heavily reworked to control that power. Extensive use of carbon fiber and magnesium reduces weight, while upgraded suspension components, rear-wheel steering, and active engine mounts sharpen responsiveness and stability. Massive air intakes, aggressive aerodynamic elements, and a towering rear wing generate serious downforce, helping the car remain planted at extreme speeds. Inside, the cabin reflects its track-focused mission. Alcantara, carbon fiber trim, lightweight bucket seats, and pull-strap door handles reduce weight while creating a purposeful environment centered entirely around driving. The layout remains familiar to 911 owners, but everything feels more intense and focused. The 2019 Porsche 911 GT2 RS stands out as one of the most extreme and capable performance cars Porsche has ever created. It combines overwhelming turbocharged power, advanced chassis engineering, and true rear-wheel-drive aggression into a machine that feels both precise and terrifyingly fast.

description: 2018 Dodge Challenger SRT Demon For Sale in "Destroyer Gray!" Demon #0709 1-Owner Clean Carfax Original Window Sticker Leather & Alcantara WE FINANCE Some cars become collectible over time. The Demon was collectible before the first one ever reached a dealership. Finished in Destroyer Gray over Black Leather and Alcantara , this 2018 Dodge Challenger SRT Demon is production number 0709 , backed by a Clean Carfax and, remarkably, still with its original owner history. That last part matters. These cars were instantly collectible, values moved dramatically after production ended, and plenty of Demons have traded hands more than once. Finding one today with a 1-owner history, original window sticker, both keys and original manuals gives you a much better story than simply finding another Demon for sale. And this isn't one of the stripped-down interior cars. It was ordered with Leather and Alcantara, the Leather Rear Seat Group, Harman Kardon 18-speaker audio, Red seat belts, Navigation and heated and ventilated seats. The Demon. Dodge didn't build the Demon to be a slightly faster Hellcat. It developed a dedicated version of the supercharged 6.2L HEMI with a larger supercharger, strengthened internal components, specialized induction, the SRT Power Chiller and an entire drivetrain engineered around one objective: Get down the drag strip as quickly as possible. On premium 91-octane fuel, the Demon produces 808 horsepower. With the appropriate high-octane calibration and fuel, Dodge rated it at 840 horsepower. The result was a factory production car Dodge officially clocked at 9.65 seconds at 140 mph in the quarter-mile. And Dodge built just 3,300 of them for the entire 2018 model year. #0709. Every original Demon carries its own serialized production number, and this one is Demon #0709. More importantly, some of the pieces collectors want to see are still with the car: Original Window Sticker Both Keys Original Owner's Manuals 1-Owner History Clean Carfax The original Demon Crate is not included with this car. We'd rather tell you that plainly than dance around it. What is here is a properly documented, one-owner example with its original paperwork and an unusually good factory interior specification. The Comfortable Demon. The Demon could famously be ordered in an extremely stripped-down configuration, but somebody ordering #0709 wanted the performance without giving up the amenities. Factory Options & Equipment Include: Leather / Alcantara Interior Group Leather Rear Seat Group Harman Kardon 18-Speaker Premium Audio System Red Seat Belts Navigation Heated Front Seats Ventilated Front Seats Black Leather & Alcantara Interior Serialized Demon #0709 That combination makes this one considerably easier to enjoy somewhere other than a drag strip while preserving everything that made the Demon ridiculous in the first place. One Year. One Purpose. The original Demon wasn't a trim level Dodge kept around. It was a one-year program. Production ended after just 3,300 cars , and Dodge moved on. That matters because there will always be another high-horsepower Challenger. Dodge itself eventually returned to the Demon name with the Demon 170. But the 2018 SRT Demon is the original modern Demon —the car that introduced the name back into the Dodge lineup and turned a factory Challenger into a purpose-built drag car with a warranty and a license plate. And #0709 has something you can't add later: One owner from new. Texas Hot Rides has specialized in enthusiast, performance and specialty vehicles in the Dallas-Fort Worth area since 2009, and modern Mopar performance cars have been a major part of what we do. From SRT8s and Hellcats to Vipers and limited-production Demons, we understand why originality, documentation and ownership history matter more as these cars become harder to find in the right condition. Destroyer Gray. Demon #0709. One owner. Clean Carfax. Original window sticker. The crate may be missing. The story isn't. This 2024 Toyota GR Supra 45th Anniversary Edition 6-Speed Manual is both and with only 1,969 miles, this is an exceptionally low-mileage example of an already extremely limited-production Supra.

Show Cars of Boca Raton is proud to offer this rare modern performance car, created to celebrate 45 years of one of the most recognizable names in Japanese automotive history. Limited to only 900 examples for the entire United States, the 45th Anniversary Edition combines exclusive styling, serious performance hardware and unmistakable Supra heritage.

More importantly for the true enthusiast, this particular car is equipped with the highly desirable 6-speed intelligent Manual Transmission.

With just 1,969 miles, a Clean CARFAX with no accidents reported, remaining factory warranty coverage and a highly desirable three-pedal configuration, this is exactly the type of GR Supra enthusiasts search nationally to find.

The 45th Anniversary Edition isn't simply an appearance package.

Toyota created it as a tribute to the legendary Supra generations that came before it, particularly the iconic MkIV cars that helped establish the Supra as one of the most celebrated performance cars of its era.

Production was limited to only 900 units for the U.S. market, making it substantially rarer than a standard GR Supra.

This example becomes even more compelling thanks to its 6-speed manual transmission and remarkably low 1,969 miles.

Toyota gave the 45th Anniversary Edition several model-specific details that immediately distinguish it from the standard 3.0 Premium:

45th Anniversary Edition Highlights:

  • Only 1,969 miles

  • Highly desirable 6-speed intelligent Manual Transmission

  • Exclusive manually adjustable rear spoiler

  • Adaptive Variable Sport suspension

382 horsepower
368 lb-ft of torque

Power is sent to the rear wheels, giving the GR Supra the classic front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout that has defined many of the world's great driver's cars.

Throttle response is immediate, midrange torque is tremendous and the inline-six delivers the smooth, relentless acceleration enthusiasts expect from a modern Supra.

But the centerpiece of this particular car is the transmission.

6-Speed Manual Transmission

Three pedals.

A real gear lever.

And complete control over one of the best turbocharged six-cylinder engines available in a modern sports car.

description: 2023 Ford Mustang Mach 1 Premium For Sale in "Shadow Black!" 6-Speed Manual Mach 1 Leather Recaro Seats Elite Package 1-Owner WE FINANCE There are plenty of ways to option a Mach 1. This is pretty close to how we'd want one. Shadow Black. 6-speed manual. Recaro seats. Mach 1 Elite Package. Satin Black graphics with the red accent. And one owner from new. This 2023 Ford Mustang Mach 1 Premium combines the hardware that made the Mach 1 special with a specification that feels exactly right for the car. Finished in Shadow Black over Black leather , this example carries Mach 1 chassis number P0987 and is equipped with the 6-speed manual transmission , rare Leather Recaro Seats, Mach 1 Elite Package, Navigation, Bang & Olufsen audio and the Satin Black with Red Accent Exterior Graphics Package. It's aggressive without trying too hard, properly optioned, and most importantly— It has three pedals. More Than an Appearance Package Ford didn't bring the Mach 1 name back just to build another Mustang GT with stripes. The modern Mach 1 was engineered as the enthusiast-focused bridge between the Mustang GT and the Shelby models, combining the naturally aspirated 5.0L V8 with additional cooling, chassis development and track-focused hardware. This one gets the transmission we'd want with it: the 6-speed manual. Then there's the Mach 1-specific MagneRide damping suspension , Brembo brakes and the additional performance hardware that separates a Mach 1 from an ordinary GT. It's a Mustang designed around the person sitting behind the wheel. And in 2023, it also represented the final model year of the S550 Mach 1. The Specification Matters Shadow Black already suits the Mach 1 exceptionally well, but the Satin Black with Red Accent Exterior Graphics Package gives this car just enough contrast to make the Mach 1 details stand out. Then you open the door. Instead of the standard seating, this one was ordered with the rare Leather Recaro Seats —one of those options that immediately changes both the appearance and personality of the interior. The Mach 1 Elite Package , Navigation and Bang & Olufsen Audio Package round out the specification without taking away from what this car is supposed to be. This wasn't ordered like an ordinary Mustang. Somebody checked the right boxes. Factory Options & Equipment Include: 6-Speed Manual Transmission Rare Leather Recaro Seats Package Mach 1 Elite Package Satin Black with Red Accent Exterior Graphics Package Navigation Bang & Olufsen Audio Package Mach 1-Specific MagneRide Damping Suspension Brembo Performance Brakes Shadow Black Exterior Black Leather Interior Mach 1 Chassis Number P0987 A Few Well-Chosen Touches The car remains very close to its factory formula, with just a few tasteful additions. An upgraded Ford Performance Shifter improves the manual-transmission experience, while a 2022 GT500-style rear spoiler with Gurney extension gives the rear of the car a little more aggression. Yellow LED pod-style fog lights and tinted windows finish off the look. Nothing here changes the identity of the car. It's still the Mach 1 Ford built—just with a few well-chosen touches. The S550 Mach 1 There's a reason the Mach 1 has already carved out its own place among modern Mustangs. It took a familiar formula— naturally aspirated 5.0L V8, rear-wheel drive and an available manual transmission —and surrounded it with the chassis, cooling and braking hardware to make the entire car more serious. And unlike a modification package added after the fact, the Mach 1 came from Ford with its own identity, its own equipment and even its own serialized chassis number. This one is P0987. Add the 6-speed manual, Leather Recaros, Elite Package, Shadow Black specification and one-owner history , and you've got exactly the kind of Mach 1 we'd rather have than one that simply checks the badge box. The right car. The right transmission. The right options. Texas Hot Rides has specialized in enthusiast, performance and specialty vehicles in the Dallas-Fort Worth area since 2009 , and Mustangs have always been an important part of what we do. From clean factory GTs to Shelby, Roush and professionally modified examples, we understand why specification matters—and a 6-speed manual Mustang Mach 1 Premium with Leather Recaros is exactly the kind of S550 we like having in our Carrollton showroom. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

description: ELECTRIFYING, RARE, RECORD-SETTING, NO-ACCIDENT, ONE-OWNER, NONSMOKER, THE WAGON AMERICA WAITED 30 YEARS FOR! This 2025 BMW M5 Touring is a genuinely historic vehicle for the American market: the first M5 wagon BMW has ever officially sold in the United States, more than 30 years after the original E34 M5 Touring debuted in Europe. Finished in Carbon Black Metallic over Black Extended Merino leather, this particular example was ordered with the M Driver's Package and Executive Package on top of an already extraordinary factory build. BMW's M Hybrid powertrain pairs a high-revving 4.4-liter twin-turbo V8 with an integrated electric motor for a combined 717 horsepower and 738 lb-ft of torque, routed through M xDrive all-wheel drive. This plug-in hybrid system also delivers an estimated 25 miles of pure electric range, meaning this M5 can slip through the neighborhood in near silence before unleashing everything it has on the on-ramp. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The M5 Touring has been offered only twice before in the model's 40-year history, and both times it stayed in Europe. BMW finally brought it stateside for this generation, making this wagon body style a genuine first for American M5 buyers rather than a grey-market curiosity. Buyers gravitate toward the M5 Touring for a combination almost nothing else on sale offers: race-derived hybrid performance, up to an estimated 57.6 cubic feet of cargo space, and the kind of rarity that comes from BMW building it for the US market for the very first time. WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 8,924-mile mark and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage New Vehicle Limited Warranty -- Covers the entire vehicle, engine, and transmission. Expiration: 03/31/2029 or 50,000 miles, whichever comes first. High-Voltage Battery Limited Warranty -- Covers the plug-in hybrid battery pack. Expiration: 03/31/2033 or 80,000 miles, whichever comes first. Want to extend its warranty coverage? In most cases, we can provide expanded options to cover each vehicle with a valuable, comprehensive warranty for years to come! STANDARD FEATURES Every M5 Touring comes remarkably well equipped from the factory, including 20/21-inch M Dual-Spoke wheels, M Compound brakes with black calipers, a Sky Lounge panoramic roof, Bowers & Wilkins surround sound, and a BMW Curved Display with head-up display, a level of standard content most performance wagons simply don't match. INSTALLED OPTIONS This M5 Touring was ordered with several genuine performance and comfort upgrades beyond its already extensive standard equipment. Package: M Driver's Package Raises the electronically limited top speed beyond the standard cap Unlocks meaningfully more top-end performance for track days or high-speed autobahn-style driving. Package: Executive Package Front and rear heated seats, front ventilated seats, and an interior camera Adds real everyday comfort and an extra layer of interior monitoring. Parking Assistant Plus and rear manual side window shades Makes tight parking situations easier and adds privacy for rear passengers. BMW Iconic Glow kidney grille A distinctive illuminated grille treatment that few other M5s on the road will have. Package: Driving Assistance Professional Active Driving Assistant Pro Adds a genuinely capable suite of semi-autonomous driving aids for long highway stretches. MECHANICAL FEATURES This M5 Touring pairs its 4.4-liter twin-turbo V8 with an integrated electric motor for a combined 717 horsepower and 738 lb-ft of torque, delivered through an 8-speed automatic transmission and M xDrive all-wheel drive. M Compound brakes with black calipers provide serious stopping power to match the performance on tap. EXTERIOR FEATURES Carbon Black Metallic paint gives this M5 Touring a deep, purposeful finish, further set off by the Black Roof, M Shadowline trim and lights, and the illuminated BMW Iconic Glow kidney grille from the Executive Package. The 20/21-inch M Dual-Spoke Dark Grey wheels round out a genuinely aggressive stance for a wagon. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, Black Extended Merino leather and Fine Wood Dark Oak trim give this cabin a genuinely upscale feel, backed by M Multi-Function seats with lumbar support and 4-zone automatic climate control. The Sky Lounge panoramic roof and Interaction Bar with ambient lighting add to an atmosphere that feels every bit as special as the performance underneath. Adventure-ready and exceptionally low-mileage, this 2025 Subaru Outback Wilderness arrives in striking Geyser Blue with just 5,700 miles. It has had one owner, comes with a clean vehicle history report, and has received recent factory service. The Wilderness trim blends rugged capability with everyday comfort, useful technology, and the confidence of Subaru Symmetrical all-wheel drive.

As a Subaru Certified Pre-Owned vehicle, this Outback has completed a comprehensive 152-point inspection and includes a 7-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty from the original in-service date. The program also includes a $0 warranty deductible, roadside assistance, transferable coverage, vehicle history benefits, a three-month SiriusXM trial, a one-year Subaru connected-services trial, and an eligible $500 Owner Loyalty coupon. It is a strong protection package designed to add confidence to every mile.

Under the hood is Subaru's turbocharged 2.4-liter engine paired with a smooth Lineartronic transmission. With an estimated 21 city/26 highway mpg, this Wilderness is ready for commuting, mountain weekends, and Pacific Northwest road trips. Matte Black 17-inch aluminum-alloy wheels, roof rails, splash guards, a trailer hitch with fascia panel, fog lights, and Wilderness styling give it the trail-ready look to match its capability.

Inside, StarTex-trimmed upholstery is practical and comfortable, with heated front and rear seats, a heated steering wheel, dual-zone automatic climate control, a power driver's seat, power moonroof, and power liftgate. The cabin also features a 12-speaker harman/kardon audio system, an 11.6-inch Subaru multimedia touchscreen with navigation, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, wireless charging, HomeLink, and an auto-dimming rearview mirror.

Active Cruise Control helps take the strain out of longer drives, while Reverse Automatic Braking, a rearview camera, automatic high beams, brake assist, stability and traction control, and four-wheel disc brakes support daily driving. Approach-light exterior mirrors, turn-signal indicators, keyless entry, automatic headlights, and a security system add everyday convenience.

Cargo protection is already in place with a cargo sidewall protector and rear seatback protector. The split-folding rear seat adds flexibility for outdoor gear, pets, groceries, and weekend equipment, while the trailer hitch expands what this Outback can bring along.

Buying a Subaru from Carter Subaru Ballard also comes with an exclusive ownership perk, Loan Cars for Life, giving our Subaru customers added convenience for qualifying service visits. Pair that with a dealership that has served generations of Seattle drivers, and this low-mileage Wilderness offers value beyond its impressive equipment list. Seattles trusted Subaru dealership since 1960.

Recent arrival vehicles this well equipped and lightly driven can attract attention quickly. Come see the Geyser Blue finish in person, explore the Wilderness-specific details, and experience the turbocharged performance for yourself.
